stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS fall 2024 (no Common Data Set found on harding.edu): 2,714 applied, 1,914 admitted (71%), 854 enrolled (45% yield). College Navigator: SAT/ACT, GPA, secondary school record, recommendations and an English proficiency test are 'required to be considered'; essay and rank are not considered. SAT submitted by 157 enrolled first-time students (18%), ACT by 643 (75%); Harding also accepts the CLT. No SAT total percentile is published (only section scores). International applicant counts, GPA distribution and residency splits are not published.
